 Outside Activities
 Member of the Board of the Victoria-Beacon Hill Riding Association of the British Columbia Liberal Party
 Recusal
 On October 5, 2023, in the exercise of my official duties, I recused myself from any discussion on a bill sponsored by a private Member which would increase the tax benefits for Canada's volunteer firefighters in order to avoid any opportunity to further the private interests of my uncle, a volunteer fire chief in Madeira Park, British Columbia.
 Compliance Order under Section 30
 WHEREAS you are appointed Policy Advisor (PACIFICAN) in the Office of the Minister of International Development and Minister responsible for the Pacific Economic Development Agency of Canada;
WHEREAS pursuant to subsection 28 of the Conflict of Interest Act, I am required to review annually with you, as a reporting public office holder, the information contained in your confidential report and the measures taken to satisfy your obligations under the Act;
WHEREAS an email dated February 18, 2022, was sent to you asking that you return all necessary documents to complete your Annual Review to the Office within 30 days; 
WHEREAS despite many reminders, your Annual Review remains outstanding on the day of this Order; 
AND WHEREAS pursuant to section 19 of the Conflict of Interest Act, compliance with the Act is a condition of a person's appointment or employment as a public office holder;
I THEREFORE ORDER YOU to submit to my Office, within 10 days, all documents identified in the letter dated February 18, 2022, all of which are required to complete your Annual Review.
